Ganesh Prallad Gaikwad And Others vs The Union Of India
Through Its Secretary ... on 30 January, 2024 
Author: Ravindra V. Ghuge Bench: Ravindra V. Ghuge  923-WP-1052-2024.odt  IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE OF BOMBAY  BENCH AT AURANGABAD  WRIT PETITION NO. 1052 OF 2024  GANESH PRALLAD GAIKWAD AND OTHERS  VERSUS THE UNION OF INDIA THROUGH ITS SECRETARY AND OTHERS  .... 
Mr. H. D. Deshmukh, Advocate for Petitioners Mr. A. N. Patale, Standing Counsel for Respondent Nos. 1 and 2 Mr. A. B. Girase, Government Pleader for Respondent Nos. 4 and 5  ....
 CORAM : RAVINDRA V. GHUGE AND  Y. G. KHOBRAGADE, JJ. 
DATE : 30.01.2024 PER COURT :-
1. Leave to place on record the report of CAG and the Parliamentary Standing Committee, with proper pagination in continuation to the Petition paper-book.
2. The Petitioners have put forth prayer Clauses (B), (C) and (D) as under:-
"[B] Issue writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ orders or directions in the like nature, thereby directing the respondents to maintain the right of equality of the exam pattern & syllabus for the post of Food Safety Officer and Assistant Commissioner (Food) Cum Designated Officer as like the other States in the Union of India as per the guidelines of respondent no.2, and for that purpose issue necessary orders. 
 1 of 2  (( 2 )) 923-WP-1052-2024 Ganesh Prallad Gaikwad And Others vs The Union Of India Through Its Secretary ... on 30 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99208516/
1 [C] Hold and declare that, the post of Food Safety Officer and Assistant Commissioner (Food) Cum Designated Officer being the technical post requires expertise knowledge fulfilling the duties and responsibilities for which the exam pattern & syllabus for the competitive examinations in the screening and selection/recruitment process should have the relevance with the duties and responsibilities of the post, as like other posts recruited by Food & Drugs department and for that purpose issue necessary orders. 
[D] Pending hearing and final disposal of this writ petition, direct the respondent no.3 to consider the revision of exam pattern & syllabus of the competitive examinations for the post of Food Safety Officer and Assistant Commissioner (Food)
Cum Designated Officer in consonance with respondent no.2, 4 and 5 and in equality with the other States in the Union of India, and for that purpose issue necessary orders."
3. Issue notice to the Respondents, returnable on 04.03.2024. The learned Standing Counsel for Union of India waives service of notice on behalf of Respondent Nos. 1 and 2. The learned Government Pleader waives service of notice on behalf of Respondent Nos. 4 and 5.
4. All office objections to be removed on or before 22.02.2024, failing which the Petition shall stand dismissed without reference to the Court on 23.02.2024. 
[ Y. G. KHOBRAGADE, J. ] [ RAVINDRA V. GHUGE, J. ] SMS 2 of 2 Ganesh Prallad Gaikwad And Others vs The Union Of India Through Its Secretary ... on 30 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99208516/
